Static Growth Plan

Updated this week
Is the Static Growth Plan right for you?

Struggling with drawdowns?

Oversizing and failing accounts?

Tired of too many restrictive rules?

Welcome to the BluSky Static Growth Plans—designed to simplify trading and help you grow.

 

Key Features: (300k Pro)

Static Drawdown: Fixed at $5,000 for the evaluation phase.

Daily Loss Limit: Capped at $2,500.

Consistency Rule: Your profit target will automatically increase if any single day’s profit exceeds 21% of your current goal. The new target is calculated to ensure that your best day represents no more than 21% of the total required profit.

Key Features: (150k/200k)

Static Drawdown: Fixed at $1,000/$2,000 for the evaluation phase.

No Daily Loss Limit

Consistency Rule: In the Evaluation phase, your profit target will automatically increase if any single day’s profit exceeds 55% of your current goal. The new target is calculated to ensure that your best day represents no more than 55% of the total required profit. In the Buffer phase, the consistency rule is 34%.

Evaluation Stage

Your sole focus is reaching the evaluation goal while staying above the static drawdown.

 

Forget complex rules—just trade with high quality and precision.

 

Buffer Earning Phase 

After passing the evaluation, you transition to a BluLive/Buffer account—a simulated account where profits contribute to your funded balance.

Your balance resets, but this is not another evaluation phase.

All profits now build your balance for the brokerage account.

 

(Only the target or profit goal (described below) of the buffer account is transferrable to Sim Funded any other Profits are forfeited.)

 

Transition to Sim Funded Account

Once you have built the buffer and hit the target profit, next steps are:

Complete the setup paperwork.

Transition to a Sim Funded Account starting with the buffer balance.

 

(Only the target or profit goal (described below) of the buffer account is transferrable to Sim Funded any other Profits are forfeited.)

 

You’ve made it this far—let’s grow together 🚀
